sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 10x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 150 seconds: Recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 150 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000
Paralysis and Psychological Contamination Resistance Up by 70

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 150 seconds.

[Aqours] Yoshiko Tsushima or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
